verdict.rationale: Shortwave is an AI-powered email client, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no documentation of any setting, policy, or guarantee that keeps user data out of AI model training. The claim that the AI 'learns your unique voice and style' describes personalization, not a training opt-out. Community privacy complaints concern server syncing and vendor sharing, not training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
